discription: A basic pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope, suitable for plucky or sustained sounds depending on the envelope settings and pulse width.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.005, 0.1, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
